SASBDB entry SASDP48  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDP48/)

Publication: GRB2 dimerization mediated by SH2 domain-swapping is critical for T cell signaling and cytokine production
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-023-30562-7

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDP48/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
